components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for primary interactions like saving or submitting.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-zen-sage); color: var(--color-zen-on-primary); padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-zen-sage); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button for less prominent interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: var(--color-zen-surface); color: var(--color-zen-herb); padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-zen-hairline); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-zen-almond); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-zen-sage); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: Active filter chip for category selection.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-zen-sage); color: var(--color-zen-on-primary); padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-zen-soft); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-chip-selected:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Default Chip
components.description: Inactive filter chip for unselected categories.
components.css: .ds-chip-default { background: var(--color-zen-panel); color: var(--color-zen-herb); padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-zen-hairline); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-chip-default:hover { border-color: var(--color-zen-hairline-strong); } .ds-chip-default:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Input Pill
components.description: Primary capture input for natural language transaction entry.
components.css: .ds-input-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(165,165,141,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; transition: box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-input-pill:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-zen-sage); } .ds-input-field { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--color-zen-sage); outline: none; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: rgba(165,165,141,0.4); } .ds-input-action { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-zen-almond); border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-input-action:hover { background: var(--color-zen-sage); color: var(--color-zen-on-primary); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Dashboard metric display card with backdrop blur.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(165,165,141,0.1); border-radius: 40px; padding: 20px; } .ds-metric-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-zen-muted); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-metric-value { display: block; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-zen-sage); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Tab
components.description: Bottom navigation tab with active state indicator.
components.html: Pulse
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: var(--color-zen-panel); border-top: 1px solid rgba(165,165,141,0.1); padding: 0 8px; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); z-index: 50; } .ds-nav-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 1rem; color: var(--color-zen-nav-inactive); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-nav-tab--active { color: var(--color-zen-sage); background: rgba(107, 112, 92, 0.14); font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav-indicator { width: 0.25rem; height: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.125rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-zen-sage); opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-nav-tab--active .ds-nav-indicator { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-nav-label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

narrative.overview: Zen Ledger feels like unbleached paper and clay: warm, rounded, quietly confident. The interface lowers financial anxiety through muted organic colors, generous whitespace, and motion that breathes rather than snaps. Surfaces float with soft shadows; numbers align with tabular precision inside friendly type.
keyCharacteristics: Warm oat background with 2% noise grain overlay
No pure black or pure white; sage and herb carry text hierarchy
Pill-shaped inputs and chips; cards use 24px-40px corner radii
Terracotta for outflows, dusty green for inflows; never punitive red
Backdrop blur on shell surfaces used sparingly for depth
View Transitions API on route changes
Custom SVG icons only; emoji for category/purpose identity

rules.name: The Calm Money Rule
rules.body: Never use pure red or alarm colors for debt or overspend. Terracotta and rose at reduced opacity carry outflow semantics.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is the only strong brand color on any screen. Terracotta and dusty green appear only on numbers and small indicators, not large fills.

rules.name: The Palette Discipline Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce off-brand hues. Extend the Zen palette or use sage-tinted semantic variants.

rules.name: The Number Alignment Rule
rules.body: All currency values use tabular-nums and Nunito 700-900. Never use proportional figures in lists or dashboards.

rules.name: The Micro Label Rule
rules.body: Metric categories use uppercase micro type with wide letter-spacing. This creates hierarchy without adding visual weight.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: Only FAB, bottom nav, modals, and primary metric cards get heavy shadows. List items use hairline borders only.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Never use colored left/right borders on cards or list items. Use background tints, icons, or full borders.

dos: Do use the Zen token classes from layout.css
Do keep bottom nav and FAB visible on all main routes
Do use active:scale-95 on tappable elements for tactile feedback
Do animate modals and sheets at 400-600ms with ease-out curves
Do use emoji for purpose/category identity
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark themes
donts: Dont use #000, #fff, navy-and-gold fintech palettes, or generic SaaS hero-metric layouts
Dont add colored side-stripe borders on cards, alerts, or list items
Dont use gradient text for amounts or headings
Dont use glassmorphism as the default for every surface
Dont import Lucide or other external icon libraries
Dont use bounce or elastic easing on UI transitions
Dont show punitive red, OVERDUE, or shame language for missed entries
Dont open modals when inline expansion or bottom sheets suffice
Dont introduce off-palette colors without mapping to Zen semantic tokens
